ui.rows.empty: Pick at least one row to practice.
ui.write.aria: Writing square. Draw the character here.
ui.cmp.model: Here's the model: {strokes}. Follow the red numbers.
ui.cmp.allright: Nice. All {n} strokes in the right order.
ui.cmp.dir: Stroke {n} goes the other way. Start where the red {n} is.
ui.cmp.order: Your stroke {n} is the model's stroke {m}. Check the order.
ui.cmp.off: Stroke {n} is off. Compare it with red stroke {n}.
ui.mn.di: It sounds like ji. Rare: じ is used almost everywhere.
ui.mn.du: It sounds like zu. Rare: ず is used almost everywhere.
ui.card.say: Say it out loud, then tap the card.
ui.learn.batch.one: 1 new verb. Read it out loud, then practice.
ui.learn.batch.other: {n} new verbs. Read each one out loud, then practice.
ui.learn.empty: Learn verbs five at a time. First the meaning, then, in Conjugate, their past, present and negative forms one at a time.
ui.learn.say: Say the meaning, then tap the card.
ui.trap.ru: Looks like a ru-verb, but it's a u-verb.
ui.trap.suru: Noun + する: only the する part changes.
ui.gloss.te: links actions: do… and…; please do…
ui.drill.empty: Add a few verbs in Learn first. Then come back to practice their forms.
ui.drill.unlocknote: {next} unlocks at {ok} right out of your last {n} answers in {cur}.
ui.drill.noforms: Turn on at least one form above.
ui.drill.keepone: Keep at least one form on.
ui.drill.typefirst: Type an answer first, or switch to Choose.
ui.rule.u.i: U-verb: change the last sound {l} to {i}, then add {suf}.
ui.rule.u.te: U-verbs ending in {ends} change it to {te}.
ui.look.title: How verb forms work
ui.look.future.p: The present form covers the future too. {taberu} means "I eat" or "I will eat". Time words like {ashita} (tomorrow) make it clearly future.
ui.look.groups.p: Ru-verbs end in -iru or -eru and simply drop {ru}. U-verbs change their last sound. Irregular: just {suru} and {kuru}. Watch out: a few -iru/-eru verbs are u-verbs, like {ex}.
ui.look.none: No verbs match. Try a meaning, kana or romaji.
ui.prog.note: Reading comes from Cards and Quiz, writing from drawing. Tap a kana for its strokes and stats.
ui.tour.0.title: Welcome to Kakitori
ui.tour.0.text: Kakitori (書き取り) means writing from memory. You'll learn kana by writing them and verbs by using them. Here's a quick look at how.
ui.tour.1.title: Write each kana
ui.tour.1.text: In Kana, Write shows a sound. Draw its kana with your finger, then tap Check. Red numbers show the right stroke order. New kana play their strokes first, and Trace adds a guide any time.
ui.tour.2.title: Read with cards and quizzes
ui.tour.2.text: Cards and Quiz train reading. Grade yourself after each card: Again brings it back in a minute, Easy pushes it out by days. Rows picks which kana you practice.
ui.tour.3.title: Verbs, five at a time
ui.tour.3.text: In Verbs, Learn adds five verbs at a time. Conjugate drills one form at a time, and the next form unlocks once you get 10 of your last 12 right.
ui.tour.4.title: Watch your progress
ui.tour.4.text: Progress colors each kana by how well you know it. Tap one to see its strokes. The gear at the top holds the language, theme, romaji, sync and backups.
ui.set.themenote: Auto follows your device's light or dark setting.
ui.set.reviewnote: Kakitori spaces reviews out as you get things right: 10 minutes, then 1 day, 3 days, a week and longer. Set a limit if you want to see everything more often.
ui.set.gaplabel: Bring each kana and verb back at least
ui.gap.auto: Kakitori will space reviews out on its own.
ui.rem.title: Reminders
ui.rem.toggle: Remind me to practice every day
ui.rem.note: Kakitori skips the reminder on days you've already practiced, and tells you how many reviews are waiting.
ui.rem.blocked: Notifications are off for Kakitori. Turn them on in your phone's settings, then switch the reminder on again.
ui.rem.ios: iPhone web apps can't schedule their own notifications. For a daily nudge, ask Siri: "Remind me every day at 7 PM to practice Japanese." You can also set a repeating reminder in the Reminders app.
ui.rem.fail: Couldn't set the reminder. Try again.
ui.notif.title: Time to practice
ui.notif.one: 1 review is ready. A few minutes keeps it fresh.
ui.notif.many: {n} reviews are ready. A few minutes keeps them fresh.
ui.notif.none: A few minutes of writing keeps your kana fresh.
ui.sync.title: Sync
ui.sync.claude.on: Your progress saves to your Claude account, so it follows you wherever you open Kakitori in Claude.
ui.sync.claude.off: Progress is saved in this browser. Open Kakitori in Claude while signed in to sync it to your account.
ui.sync.claude.phones: The phone apps sync separately, through GitHub or Google. To move progress between them and this version, use a backup code below.
ui.sync.gh.where: Saving to {repo} on GitHub. To sync another phone, set up GitHub sync there with the same repository and token.
ui.sync.gs.where: To sync another phone, paste the same sync address into its Google sync settings. Anyone with the address can see and change your progress, so keep it private.
ui.sync.gh.title: Sync with GitHub
ui.sync.gh.intro: Your progress goes into a private repository in your GitHub account. Setup takes about three minutes.
ui.sync.gh.s1: Create a private repository named {name}. Open {link}, type the name, choose Private, tick Add a README file, then click Create repository.
ui.sync.gh.s2: Make a token that can only reach that repository. Open {link} and name it Kakitori. Under Repository access, choose Only select repositories and pick kakitori-progress. Under Permissions, give it Contents access set to Read and write. Click Generate token, then copy the token.
ui.sync.gh.s3: Paste your repository and the token here.
ui.sync.gh.private: The token stays on this phone. Keep it private, and don't paste it into chats or emails.
ui.sync.gh.other: Already set up on your other phone? Use the same repository and token. GitHub shows a token only once, so if you didn't keep it, make another one the same way.
ui.sync.gs.title: Sync with Google
ui.sync.gs.intro: Your progress goes into a small script in your Google account. Setup takes about five minutes and is easiest on a computer.
ui.sync.gs.s1: Open {link} while signed in to Google. It makes a new Apps Script project.
ui.sync.gs.s2: Delete the sample code and paste the Kakitori sync script.
ui.sync.gs.s3: Click Deploy, then New deployment. Choose the type Web app. Set Execute as to Me and Who has access to Anyone, then click Deploy.
ui.sync.gs.s4: Allow access when Google asks. If it says Google hasn't verified this app, click Advanced, then Go to the project. It's your own script.
ui.sync.gs.s5: Copy the Web app URL, which ends in /exec, and paste it here.
ui.sync.gs.other: Already set up on another phone? Paste that phone's sync address in step 5.
ui.sync.choose.intro: Keep your progress the same on your Android phone and iPhone, and safe if you reinstall. Both options are free.
ui.sync.choose.note: GitHub saves to a private repository in your account. Google saves through a small script you add to your account.
ui.sync.gh.badtoken: Paste the token from GitHub. It usually starts with github_pat_.
ui.sync.gh.onpublic: GitHub sync is on. That repository is public, so anyone can see your progress. You can make it private in its GitHub settings.
ui.sync.gs.selectscript: Select the script and copy it.
ui.sync.gs.devurl: That is a test URL ending in /dev. Use the Web app URL from Deploy, which ends in /exec.
ui.sync.gs.badurl: Paste the Web app URL from Apps Script. It starts with https://script.google.com and ends in /exec.
ui.sync.addrselect: Select the address below and copy it.
ui.sync.offtoast: {svc} sync is off on this phone. Your progress saved in {svc} stays there.
ui.err.offline: You're offline. Kakitori will sync when you're back online.
ui.err.timeout: {svc} took too long to answer. Kakitori will try again shortly.
ui.err.conflict: Another phone was saving at the same time. Tap Sync now to try again.
ui.err.unreadable: The saved progress couldn't be read. Make a backup code below first, then turn sync off and set it up again.
ui.err.gh.network: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
ui.err.gh.401: GitHub didn't accept the token. It may have expired, or part of it was cut off when you pasted it. Make a new token and paste it again.
ui.err.gh.ratelimit: GitHub asked Kakitori to slow down. Sync will work again within the hour.
ui.err.gh.403: The token isn't allowed to change {repo}. Check that it has access to that repository, with Contents set to Read and write.
ui.err.gh.404: Kakitori can't find {repo}. Check the spelling, and that the token was given access to that repository.
ui.err.gh.owner: Enter the repository with your GitHub username in front, like your-username/kakitori-progress.
ui.err.gh.other: GitHub reported a problem (error {code}). Try again in a moment.
ui.err.gs.network: Couldn't reach your sync script. Check that the deployment's "Who has access" is set to Anyone, and that you copied the Web app URL ending in /exec.
ui.err.gs.other: Your sync script reported a problem ({code}). Try deploying it again.
ui.backup.title: Backup codes
ui.backup.note: A backup code holds all your progress as text. Use one to move progress between the phone app and the Claude version, or keep a copy somewhere safe.
ui.backup.select: Select the code and copy it.
ui.backup.bad: That code didn't work. Copy the whole code and try again.
ui.start.title: Start over
ui.start.note: Erase all kana and verb progress on this device.
ui.start.notesync: Erase all kana and verb progress on this device. Sync will bring it back unless you turn sync off first.

ui.about.translations: This translation and its memory hints were written with AI help and may contain mistakes.

hints.あ: A cross with a big looping body: an apple skewered on a stick. Ah!
hints.い: Two strokes side by side, like the two i's in 'ii'.
hints.う: A small dash over a curve: a U lying on its side, wearing a cap.
hints.え: A dash, then a zigzag with a kicking tail: an energetic dancer.
hints.お: Like あ, plus a dot flying off to the right: an oar splashing.
hints.か: A blade with a spark beside it: ka! a karate chop.
hints.き: A key: two bars across the shaft and a curl at the bottom.
hints.く: A beak opening to the right: a cuckoo calling ku.
hints.け: A post, then a bar with a long tail: a keg with a tap.
hints.こ: Two short worms lying parallel: a cozy couple.
hints.さ: Like き with one bar taken away. Sa: subtract a bar.
hints.し: One long fishhook: she is fishing.
hints.す: A bar with a loop swinging down the middle: a swing.
hints.せ: A long bar on two legs, one curving: a settee bench.
hints.そ: One zigzag stroke ending in a wave: sewing thread.
hints.た: A t on the left and こ on the right: ta.
hints.ち: A cross over a backwards 5: a cheerleader, arms out.
hints.て: A bar curling down: an outstretched hand (te means hand).
hints.と: A thorn poking into a toe.
hints.な: A cross plus a knotted loop: a knot in a rope.
hints.に: A stick beside two short lines: a knee next to こ.
hints.ぬ: め with a loop at the end: noodles twirled on a fork.
hints.ね: A stick and a wavy body ending in a curl: a cat's tail (neko).
hints.の: One swirl, like a no-entry sign drawn in a single stroke.
hints.は: Like け, but the right side ends in a loop: ha ha, a big belly laugh.
hints.ひ: A wide grin with a dimple: hee hee.
hints.ふ: Four scattered strokes: Mount Fuji with clouds around it.
hints.へ: A single mountain peak: shout hey from the top.
hints.ほ: は with an extra bar on top: a house with one more floor.
hints.ま: Two bars and a loop at the bottom: mama holding a baby.
hints.み: A loop with a trailing tail, crossed by a slash: a music note, mi.
hints.む: A cross, a loop and a dot: a cow's head going moo.
hints.め: Crossed strokes forming an eye (me means eye).
hints.も: A fishhook with two bars: catch more fish.
hints.や: A curved horn, a dot and a long slash: a yak's horn.
hints.ゆ: A loop with a line running through it: a fish swimming in a U.
hints.よ: A yo-yo hanging from a short bar.
hints.ら: A short tick over a curve: a rabbit sitting, one ear up.
hints.り: Two reeds standing, the right one longer.
hints.る: ろ with a loop at the end: a road ending in a roundabout.
hints.れ: Like ね, but the end kicks out instead of curling: a leg kicking.
hints.ろ: A winding road: る without the loop.
hints.わ: Like ね, but it ends in an open round belly: wa, wide.
hints.を: A person swinging a bat: whoa!
hints.ん: A lowercase n with a tail.
hints.ア: An axe: a hooked blade and a handle.
hints.イ: A person leaning on a post: an easel.
hints.ウ: う with a roof: a cap over a box.
hints.エ: An elevator shaft between two floors.
hints.オ: A cross with a slash: an oar dipping into water.
hints.カ: か without the spark: just the karate chop.
hints.キ: き in straight lines: a key with two bars.
hints.ク: A hook with a short tick: a cook's ladle.
hints.コ: Two sides of a box: a corner.
hints.サ: A bar held up by two posts, one curving: a saddle.
hints.シ: Two dots, then a stroke rising from the bottom left: she smiles. (ツ falls from the top.)
hints.ス: A bar, then a slash with a kick: a sumo wrestler's stance.
hints.ソ: A dot, then a long stroke falling from the top: a sewing needle. (ン rises from the bottom.)
hints.タ: ク with a stroke inside: a taco with filling.
hints.チ: ち straightened out: a cheerleader holding a pole.
hints.ツ: Two dots, then a long stroke falling from the top right: tsunami spray. (シ rises.)
hints.テ: Two bars and a drooping stroke: a telephone pole.
hints.ト: A totem pole with one branch.
hints.ナ: A cross with a long leaning leg: a knife.
hints.ヌ: ス with a slash through it: noodles caught by chopsticks.
hints.ネ: A dot, a fold and two legs: a nest on a branch.
hints.ハ: Two strokes spreading apart: ha, a puff of breath.
hints.ヒ: A bar with a bending line: the heel of a shoe.
hints.フ: One folded stroke: the top of Mount Fuji.
hints.ヘ: Same as へ: a mountain peak.
hints.ホ: A cross with two little legs: a holy cross.
hints.マ: A fold with a dot: mama's apron pocket.
hints.ム: A pointed nose with a nostril: a cow, moo.
hints.モ: Two bars and a hook: more bars than も has curves.
hints.ヤ: や in straight lines: a yak's horn.
hints.ユ: A U-turn sitting on a base: you turn.
hints.ヨ: A backwards E: a yo-yo string coiled up.
hints.ラ: A bar over フ: a rabbit's ear over its head.
hints.リ: り in straight lines: two reeds.
hints.ル: Two roots, the right one kicking up.
hints.レ: One stroke down and up, like a check mark: reh.
hints.ワ: A corner with a waterfall pouring down: wa.
hints.ヲ: フ with an extra bar: whoa, arms out.
hints.ン: Like ソ, but the long stroke sweeps up from the bottom: n.

verbs: to sleep, to go to bed
to rest, to take a day off
